=== bm1684x ===
commit 99fb6f9d2c6c920724782950ac71a95289ae5d33
Author: junliang.liu <junliang.liu@sophgo.com>
Date:   Mon Sep 28 14:01:22 2026 +0800

    [fix][sg2262][hau] LMEM round-robin for c>NPU_NUM
    
    HAU opd0_c > NPU_NUM channels were addressed as one full LMEM lane
    per channel (c * LOCAL_MEM_SIZE), which cannot represent more
    channels than there are NPU lanes.  Spec 2.1.2 lays them out
    round-robin instead: lane = c % NPU_NUM, and each full lap advances
    the in-lane offset by one row.
    
    Address both ends with the same formula:
    - cmodel: lmem_lane_addr() plus an assertion that one lap of rows
      still fits a single lane.  dump_hau_tensor_range() now dumps once
      per lane over rounds * lane_bytes; dumping per channel re-emitted
      the same lane run piecemeal.
    - tv_gen: scatter and clear the same round-robin layout, and extend
      the random dim_c range up to NPU_NUM.  Merge keeps opd0/opd1 in
      disjoint lap sets, so its opd1 offset becomes a fixed NPU_NUM/2
      lanes instead of dim_c lanes.
    
    For c <= NPU_NUM the formula degenerates to the old one, so existing
    single-lap cases are unchanged.
    
    Change-Id: If039fefe0c0986700d1c04c9ca2290206bc4911a
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
=== bm1688 ===
commit 966fe14486d1b03d375d5e3211f5b43d3207eeb5
Author: yujia liu <yujia.liu@sophgo.com>
Date:   Mon Oct 19 15:37:02 2026 +0800

    fix(bm1688/bm1684x2): fast not_perchannel path for requant and dequant
    
    MLIR-973: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 int8 is 2.69x slower than fp16 on bm1688
    (141.96ms vs 52.75ms), while accuracy is unchanged.  bm1686 lacks the
    not_perchannel fast path that bm1684x has, on both the requant and the
    dequant side.  Without it the per-op cost is too high, so the layer
    group partitioner folds the gelu chain into one over-large group and
    splits it 17 ways: 99,270 TIU instructions.
    
    Add both fast paths, ported from bm1684x.  The fixed 16-bank buffer
    layout fits bm1686 (128KB/16 banks) and bm1684x2 (256KB/16 banks); the
    surrounding else-branch in nodechip_dequant.c/nodechip_requant.c also
    serves sg2262 (64KB/8 banks) and others, so restrict the new path to
    __bm1686__ and __bm1684x2__.  INT4/UINT4 stay on the generic path
    because tpu_data_type_size() rejects them.
    
    Verified on bm1688: DINOv2 int8 141.96ms -> 34.01ms (0.64x of fp16),
    TIU instructions 99,270 -> 19,350, model output bit-identical.  The
    int4 cases of test_onnx (Conv2d/MatMul/MatMul2) pass.
    
    Verified on bm1684x2 (cv84x6): DINOv2 int8 48 -> 36 layer groups,
    instruct 6,566,784 -> 1,690,368 bytes, profile commands 107,899 ->
    28,327, cmodel output bit-identical.  s5 regression: 23/23 cmodel and
    70/70 tvgen tests pass (EDA firmware build skipped locally: the riscv
    toolchain is not installed).
    
    Change-Id: I973de9a4b21c3e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90123
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
